fragments.text: Source paraphrase: Issues arise during the daily Verification Station or weekly Problem Solving report-out meeting. Assignments made there are entered in an Assignment Action Sheet and reviewed at the next meeting. Examples of issues include material presentation, delivery, and support needed for work.
